verified_fixes: New apiDataExtractor.js utility properly handles paginated and non-paginated API responses
extractArray() function handles: direct arrays, {items:[]}, {results:[]}, {data:[]}, null/undefined
ErrorBoundary.js provides graceful error handling with user-friendly messages
All pages use standardized pattern: const data = response.data?.items || response.data || []; setData(Array.isArray(data) ? data : [])
notes_on_console_warnings: Console shows React hydration warnings like '<span> cannot be a child of <select>'
These are NOT 'Objects are not valid as React child' errors
These warnings are from Emergent editor's span injection for debugging (x-file-name, x-line-number attributes)
These warnings do not affect functionality and are development-mode only
context_for_next_testing_agent: All pages tested for 'Objects are not valid as React child' fix are working correctly.
